questions.stem: What type of circulatory system do humans have?
questions.explanation: Humans have a double circulatory system. Blood passes through the heart twice on each complete circuit: once through the lungs (pulmonary circulation) and once through the body (systemic circulation).

questions.stem: What are the three main components of the circulatory system?
questions.explanation: The circulatory system consists of the heart (pump), blood vessels (tubes that carry blood), and blood (transport medium carrying substances around the body).

options.text: Blood flow through the liver only
Blood flow from heart to body and back
Blood flow from heart to lungs and back to the heart

questions.explanation: Pulmonary circulation carries deoxygenated blood from the right side of the heart to the lungs, where it picks up oxygen, and then returns oxygenated blood to the left side of the heart.

questions.stem: Why is a double circulatory system more efficient than a single one?

options.text: Blood pressure is maintained at a higher level for the body, allowing faster delivery of oxygen and nutrients

questions.explanation: A double system allows blood to be pumped at high pressure to the body after being oxygenated in the lungs, which would reduce pressure in a single system. This ensures efficient delivery of substances.

questions.stem: Which blood vessel carries blood away from the heart?
questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart. They have thick muscular walls and small lumens to withstand and maintain high blood pressure.

questions.stem: What is the main function of the circulatory system?

options.text: To transport oxygen, nutrients, hormones, and waste products around the body

questions.explanation: The circulatory system transports oxygen and nutrients to cells, removes waste products like carbon dioxide, carries hormones to target organs, and helps fight infection.

options.text: Blood flow from the left side of the heart to the body and back to the right side
Blood flow in the kidneys only
The flow of lymph around the body
Blood flow between the heart and lungs

questions.explanation: Systemic circulation carries oxygenated blood from the left ventricle to all body tissues and returns deoxygenated blood to the right atrium of the heart.
